integrity: Exact formula proved by disjoint classification by count of ones; stochastic limit proved from lattice simplex convergence; first two limiting moments evaluated by exact exponential integrals. Independent enumeration and rational checks are supplementary, not substitutes for proof. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Binary words with exactly three ones only; distinct nonempty scattered palindromic subsequences, not contiguous factors. Limiting distribution given as simplex pushforward; neither a closed elementary density nor higher fixed weights is established. Earlier literature may contain unindexed equivalent formulations.
title: Exact scattered-palindrome complexity and limit law for binary words with three ones
